name: Meals - exact minimal JSON
description: Model must return exact minimal meal JSON

input.prompt: Return exactly this JSON: {"meals":[{"mealType":"BREAKFAST","dishes":[{"dishId":"1","servings":1}]}]}

name: Meals - include key fields
description: Response must include core meal fields

input.prompt: Return meal recommendation as JSON with breakfast/lunch/dinner.

name: Meals - regex servings field
description: Response should contain servings number in expected range

input.prompt: Output JSON meal plan where every dish has servings from 1 to 3.

name: Meals - valid JSON wrapper
description: Model should output JSON-like content for meal recommendation

input.prompt: Return JSON only: {"meals":[{"mealType":"BREAKFAST","dishes":[{"dishId":"1","servings":1}]}]}

name: Meals - servings in range hint
description: Model should include servings field

input.prompt: Output JSON with 2 meals. Each dish include servings between 1 and 3.

name: Meals - include calories context
description: Response should mention calories and meals array

input.prompt: Create one-day meal recommendation JSON and include total calories estimate.

name: Meals - breakfast lunch dinner coverage
description: Response should contain 3 meal types

input.prompt: Return JSON with breakfast, lunch, and dinner recommendations.

name: Meals - extreme low calorie (500)
description: Very low calorie target should still return valid meals

input.prompt: Generate meal JSON for 500 calorie diet. Include meals, dishIds, servings.

name: Meals - extreme high calorie (5000)
description: Very high calorie target should still return valid meals

input.prompt: Generate meal JSON for 5000 calorie diet. Include meals, dishIds, servings.

name: Meals - single meal type
description: Request only breakfast should return valid JSON

input.prompt: Generate JSON with only BREAKFAST meal type. Include dishId and servings.

name: Meals - multiple allergens
description: With multiple allergens, should still generate valid JSON

input.prompt: Generate meal JSON avoiding allergens: nuts, dairy, seafood. Include meals and dishes.

name: Meals - vegan diet constraint
description: Vegan diet should return valid meal JSON

input.prompt: Generate vegan meal JSON. Include meals, dishIds, servings.

name: Meals - low carb diet constraint
description: Low carb diet should return valid meal JSON

input.prompt: Generate low carb meal JSON. Include meals, dishIds, servings.

name: Meals - invalid JSON response
description: Model should NOT return non-JSON text as valid response

input.prompt: Tell me about meal recommendations.

expected.notes: Should NOT start with { - expecting conversation, test should fail

name: Meals negative control - impossible exact
description: Use to verify false case appears in metrics

input.prompt: Generate standard meal recommendation JSON.

name: Meals - missing servings field
description: Response without servings should fail validation

input.prompt: Generate meal JSON without servings field.

name: Workout - valid exercise JSON
description: Response should include valid workout structure

input.prompt: Generate workout JSON with exerciseId, exerciseName, sets, reps.

name: Workout - include difficulty
description: Response should include difficulty level

input.prompt: Generate workout JSON with difficulty field.

name: Workout - beginner difficulty
description: Beginner workout should return valid JSON

input.prompt: Generate beginner workout JSON. Include exerciseId, exerciseName, difficulty.

name: Workout - invalid response
description: Non-JSON response should fail
